mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sim_history ( simulation_id, time, average_queue_length, average_customer_wait_seat_seconds, chef_utilization, seat_turnover, seat_idle_rate, congestion_rate ) VALUES
(#{simId}, #{item.time}, #{item.averageQueueLength}, #{item.averageCustomerWaitSeatSeconds}, #{item.chefUtilization}, #{item.seatTurnover}, #{item.seatIdleRate}, #{item.congestionRate})
mapper.select: SELECT time, average_queue_length AS averageQueueLength, average_customer_wait_seat_seconds AS averageCustomerWaitSeatSeconds, chef_utilization AS chefUtilization, seat_turnover AS seatTurnover, seat_idle_rate AS seatIdleRate, congestion_rate AS congestionRate FROM sim_history WHERE simulation_id = #{simId} ORDER BY time ASC
